source_caption:
### Landman (2024) — Every Barrel Comes With a Price 🛢️

Landman is a drama series starring Billy Bob Thornton as Tommy Norris, a seasoned crisis manager caught in the high-stakes oil business of West Texas. Between wealthy oil executives, hardworking crews, and dangerous deals, Tommy spends his days managing chaos in an industry where fortunes can be made overnight and mistakes can cost everything.

As the pressure builds, Tommy finds himself navigating corporate rivalries, criminal threats, unexpected disasters, and complicated family relationships. Every decision carries consequences, and the people around him are willing to take enormous risks to protect their money and influence. In a world driven by profit, doing the right thing is rarely simple.

The series explores power, greed, ambition, loyalty, and the sacrifices behind success. It reveals the human cost of an industry fueled by enormous wealth, where personal relationships can become collateral damage and even the most experienced people can find themselves in over their heads.

What makes Landman stand out is its intense portrayal of life behind the oil boom. Beneath the money and machinery lies a constant battle between survival, responsibility, and the desire for more.

💬 “When billions are on the line, every decision has a price—and not everyone can afford to pay it.”

source_details.synopsis: Landman is an American drama series created by Taylor Sheridan and Christian Wallace, inspired by the podcast series Boomtown hosted by Wallace. Starring Billy Bob Thornton as a landman for an oil company, the show premiered on November 17, 2024, on Paramount+. In March 2025, the series was renewed for a second season, which premiered on November 16, 2025. In December 2025, the series was renewed for a third season. Despite some elements igniting controversy, the series has been received positively by critics overall.
